help.section.welcome.title: 欢迎来到《Little Genius》
help.section.welcome.intro: 欢迎，Soulframe的使节。《Little Genius》是你在Soulframe中的随行伙伴——一款用于追踪进度、规划路线与查询资料的工具，专为喜欢掌控一切进展的人打造。本指南将涵盖所有视图与功能，帮助你随时知道该去哪里查看所需信息。
help.section.welcome.gettingAround.title: 功能导航
help.section.welcome.gettingAround.body: 左侧边缘是导航栏——每个图标都可带你进入不同的视图。右侧侧边栏会一览显示计时器、资源和制作信息。大多数面板都带有搜索栏，你可以快速筛选并找到所需内容。
help.section.welcome.liveSync.title: 实时同步
help.section.welcome.liveSync.body: 游戏运行时，背包、资源和锻造计时器会自动更新——无需手动录入。侧边栏中的状态标识会显示当前同步状态：实时（已同步）、过期（使用上次会话缓存）或等待中。
help.section.welcome.searchBar.title: 使用搜索栏
help.section.welcome.searchBar.body: 每个主要视图都配有搜索栏。输入物品名称的任意部分即可筛选列表。侧边栏搜索还会筛选当前标签页中的所有卡片。切换视图时，搜索内容会自动重置。
help.section.interactivity.title: 右键高亮
help.section.interactivity.intro: 部分卡片和列表行隐藏了额外操作，可通过右键菜单打开。出现小型视觉提示时，表示该项支持右键操作。
help.section.interactivity.whatItMeans.b: 卡片或列表行周围出现黄色虚线边框时，表示右键点击可打开包含额外操作的上下文菜单 — 通常用于置顶，也可能包含其他操作。
help.section.interactivity.tryIt.title: 立即尝试
help.section.interactivity.tryIt.body: 右键点击任意带有高亮提示的卡片或列表项，即可打开菜单。按 Esc 键或点击其他区域可关闭菜单。
help.section.interactivity.whereYouSeeIt: 物品卡片、资源卡片、强化条目、势力卡片、工坊卡片和世界 Boss 计时器都支持此功能。
help.section.privacy.title: 数据与隐私
help.section.privacy.intro: 你的数据仅保留在本地设备上。《Little Genius》所记录的一切内容均存储在本地——未经你的明确同意，不会进行任何共享或传输。你的进度、构筑和设置完全属于你自己。
help.section.privacy.localOnly.title: 仅本地存储
help.section.privacy.localOnly.body: 背包、锻造计时器、排名以及个人资料数据均仅缓存于你的本地设备。该缓存经过加密，并绑定到你的设备。关闭应用或重启电脑不会删除这些数据。
help.section.privacy.progressTracking.bo: 你的物品勾选标记、资源标记、已标记的首领以及构筑保存内容，均存储在浏览器的本地存储中。它们会在不同会话之间自动保留。
help.section.privacy.analytics.title: 使用情况分析（仅限网页版）
help.section.privacy.analytics.body: 網頁版使用 Google Analytics 來統計造訪次數並了解哪些頁面有人使用，以便我們知道需要改進哪些內容。它會收集標準的瀏覽器資訊（瀏覽過的頁面、大致位置、裝置類型），但絕不會收集你追蹤的物品或帳戶資料。桌面應用程式不會傳送任何分析資料。使用瀏覽器的追蹤器或廣告封鎖程式即可將其關閉。
help.section.privacy.signIn.title: Signing In (Optional)
help.section.privacy.signIn.body: Signing in with your Avakot account, by email or Discord, lets Little Genius recognise your Patreon tier so supporter perks switch on. It is optional: every core feature works without an account.
help.section.privacy.cloudBackup.title: Cloud Sync (Optional)
help.section.privacy.cloudBackup.body: Cloud Sync is a supporter feature and stays off until you turn it on. It backs up settings only, such as toggles, pins, keybinds and notification preferences, never your account credentials.
打开用户界面并滚动至底部。“删除所有数据”按钮将清除所有缓存文件和本地设置。此操作为永久性操作，无法撤销。
help.section.catalog.title: 个人收藏
help.section.catalog.about: The Collection view lists every weapon, armor piece and pact in Soulframe, plus Discoveries and Tempers. Mark what you own, filter by status, and watch the counters at the top fill up.
help.section.catalog.markingItems.title: 标记物品
help.section.catalog.markingItems.body: 点击任意物品卡片即可打开。在详情中，可以在未拥有 → 已锻造 → 已精通之间切换。页面顶部会实时更新你的总计数据。当处于同步状态时，你的实际拥有情况会自动更新这些标记。
help.section.catalog.gridList.title: 网格与列表模式
help.section.catalog.gridList.body: 通过视图顶部附近的图标，可在网格模式（图像卡片）与列表模式（紧凑表格）之间切换。列表模式支持可排序列——点击列标题即可按名称、精通经验值或其他字段进行排序。
help.section.catalog.statusFilter.title: Filtering by Status
help.section.catalog.statusFilter.body: Use the filter next to the search bar to show All, Owned, Missing, Mastered or Unmastered items. Discoveries and Tempers have their own filters, such as Unknown, In Progress and Unlocked.
顶部的搜索栏可按物品名称进行筛选。该视图还会按武器类别对武器进行分组——向下滚动即可查看所有分组，或使用折叠按钮隐藏你已处理完的分组。
help.section.catalog.counters.title: Completion Counters
help.section.catalog.counters.body: The counters at the top of the view track how many items in each category you own and how many you have mastered.
help.section.catalog.contextMenu.title: Right-Click Actions
help.section.catalog.contextMenu.body: Right-click an item card for quick actions: pin it to the top of its group, hide it from the list, compare it with another item, or add it to the Planner.
help.section.enhancements.heading: Enchantments
help.section.enhancements.about: The Enchantments view tracks your Totems and Runes: how many copies you own at each rank, what they do, and how many Harmonies it takes to max them.
help.section.enhancements.totemRows.body: Totems are passive bonuses for your weapons. Each row shows the totem's Animal, Combat Art and rarity, and how many copies you hold unranked and at Rank 1 to 3. Click a column header, Animal included, to sort by it.
help.section.enhancements.runeRows.title: Runes
help.section.enhancements.runeRows.body: Runes sit in the same table with the same rank columns. A Rune only needs one copy at Rank 3.
help.section.enhancements.harmonies.body: The Harmonies column shows what it costs to take an enchantment from your highest copy to the maximum rank. With Completionist Mode on (Settings, General), Totems aim for three Rank 3 copies, one per weapon slot.
help.section.enhancements.copiesOwned.bo: Filter by Copies Owned: Not owned, Owned or Duplicates. Not owned shows what is left to farm, and Duplicates lists the spares you can release.
help.section.enhancements.pinRows.title: Right-Click Actions
help.section.enhancements.pinRows.body: Right-click any Totem or Rune row to pin it to the top of the list.
help.section.cosmetics.title: 外觀
help.section.cosmetics.intro: 外观视图用于追踪各类外观物品——包括角色装饰、表情动作、幻化皮肤以及其他收藏品。你可以按类型进行筛选，并标记你已拥有的内容。
help.section.cosmetics.avatarMotifs.body: 角色头像是显示在你个人资料上的符号图像。当处于同步状态时，你当前使用的纹样会自动显示在侧边栏的标题区域。
help.section.cosmetics.trackingOwnership: 外观物品的标记方式与武器相同——在每个卡片上使用切换按钮即可。不过外观没有“精通等级”，因此只有简单的已拥有 / 未拥有两种状态。
help.section.cosmetics.filteringByType.b: 使用筛选标签可缩小范围至特定外观类别。搜索栏同样支持对所有外观名称进行查找。
help.section.armory.title: 军械库
help.section.armory.about: The Armory shows your in-game loadouts and keeps your saved builds. Turn a loadout into a build, make one from scratch, or import one from Avakot Build.
help.section.armory.loadouts.title: Your Loadouts
help.section.armory.loadouts.body: Your Main Loadout and your other loadout presets appear at the top with their weapons, pact, runes, totems and tempers. Create presets in game and they show up here.
help.section.armory.savedBuilds.title: Saved Builds
help.section.armory.savedBuilds.body: Use Create Build to start from scratch, or the Build button on a loadout to copy it. Builds are stored on your device. Free accounts keep up to three; supporters have no limit.
help.section.armory.editing.title: Editing a Build
help.section.armory.editing.body: Edit opens a build so you can change its weapons, pact, armor, runes, totems, tempers and notes.
help.section.armoryCodes.heading: Sharing & Importing Builds
help.section.armoryCodes.about: Builds travel through Avakot Build, the build site at avakot.build. Share sends a build there, and Import brings one back.
help.section.armoryCodes.sharing.title: Sharing
help.section.armoryCodes.sharing.body: Share on a loadout or a saved build opens it on Avakot Build in your browser. Sign in there, review it, then Save & share to get a link you can send to anyone.
help.section.armoryCodes.importing.title: Importing
help.section.armoryCodes.importing.body: Click Import Build and paste an avakot.build link or build code. Older Little Genius build codes still import too. A build you imported and have not changed shares its original page.
help.section.itemChest.title: 库存
help.section.itemChest.about: The Item Chest is the first tab of the Codex. It shows every weapon copy in your inventory with its quality, tempers and Moonsteel status.
help.section.itemChest.whatsInChest.body: 与图鉴不同（图鉴每种武器只记录一个条目），库存会显示你拥有的每一把武器实物副本——包括带有不同品质等级或淬鍊的重复武器。
help.section.itemChest.filters.title: Filters
help.section.itemChest.filters.body: Edit filters narrows the chest by weapon, rarity tier, tempers and Moonsteel. Click a temper once to require it and again to require it doubled. Filters combine.
help.section.itemChest.sorting.title: 排序
help.section.itemChest.sorting.body: 可按名称、掉落时间（最新或最旧）、精通经验进度或品质进行排序。这在你需要找出最早获得的重复物品以决定保留哪些时非常有用。
help.section.itemChest.detail.title: Weapon Detail
help.section.itemChest.detail.body: Click a weapon to open its detail view with every temper and curse it rolled. Chest statistics gives totals for what is currently shown.
help.section.itemChest.layout.title: Grid or List
help.section.itemChest.layout.body: The toggle in the toolbar switches between cards and a compact sortable table.
help.section.itemChest.dropAlerts.title: Drop Alerts
help.section.itemChest.dropAlerts.body: Little Genius can notify you about new weapons: one alert for drops that match your chest alert filters and one for Moonsteel. Both are switched under Settings, Notifications. A weapon you receive in a trade does not count as a drop.
help.section.tuvalkane.heading: Tuvalkane
help.section.tuvalkane.about: Tuvalkane is the second tab of the Codex: your crafting record with the smith.
help.section.tuvalkane.rank.title: Rank & XP
help.section.tuvalkane.rank.body: The header shows your rank with Tuvalkane and the XP behind it.
help.section.tuvalkane.qualities.title: Crafted Qualities
help.section.tuvalkane.qualities.body: Each weapon shows which quality tiers you have crafted. Click one for the full list.
help.section.tuvalkane.epithets.title: Epithets
help.section.tuvalkane.epithets.body: The Epithets section lists every weapon epithet with its unlock condition and your progress. Unfinished ones sort to the top, closest first.
help.section.stats.heading: Stats
help.section.stats.about: Stats is the third tab of the Codex. It totals what you have done with each weapon and pact, and against each kind of foe.
help.section.stats.timePlayed.title: Time Played
help.section.stats.timePlayed.body: Your total time played is shown at the top of the Stats tab, and in the account panel.
help.section.stats.weaponsPacts.title: Weapons & Pacts
help.section.stats.weaponsPacts.body: The Weapons and Pacts tabs list kills, XP and time used for each one. Click a column header to sort.
help.section.stats.foes.title: Foes
help.section.stats.foes.body: The Foes tab lists kills, assists, headshots and executions for each enemy type, with totals.
help.section.mastery.heading: Mastery Helper
help.section.mastery.about: Mastery Helper answers what to level next. It has three tabs: Mastery Helper, Session Analysis and Planner.
help.section.mastery.whatIsLeft.title: What Is Left
help.section.mastery.whatIsLeft.body: The first tab shows your Envoy Rank, how far you are into it, and every weapon, pact and Discovery that still has mastery to give. Show completed brings back the finished ones.
help.section.mastery.showOnMap.title: Show on Soulmap
help.section.mastery.showOnMap.body: Discoveries have a Show on Soulmap button that opens the map on that spot.
help.section.mastery.sessionAnalysis.bod: See mastery gained, item XP, time played and mastery per hour for this session or the last one, plus every item you gained and every weapon that dropped. Supporters also get 7 day, 30 day and all time ranges, and per-item graphs.
help.section.mastery.planner.title: Planner
help.section.mastery.planner.body: The Planner tab lists the weapons and pacts you are missing, can add them all to the sidebar Planner, and estimates the time to reach rank 30 on what you own.
help.section.journal.title: 会话日志
help.section.journal.about: The Journal is a running log of what changed on your account while Little Genius was open: items, currency, XP, kills, crafts and more, grouped by game session.
help.section.journal.entries.title: What Gets Logged
help.section.journal.entries.body: Each line is one change: an item or currency gained or spent, weapon XP, enemy kills, crafts, rune, totem and joinery changes, companion training, epithet progress and learned tempers.
help.section.journal.sessions.title: Game Sessions
help.section.journal.sessions.body: Entries are grouped into game sessions. A session ends with a recap of what changed in your stats during it.
help.section.journal.search.title: Search
help.section.journal.search.body: Use the search box to find text in the journal and jump between matches.
help.section.journal.history.title: History & Export
help.section.journal.history.body: Free accounts see the last 30 days. Supporters keep the full history and can export the journal, or a single session, as CSV.
help.section.journal.popOut.title: Pop-Out
help.section.journal.popOut.body: The Journal can open in its own window, handy for keeping it on a second screen.
help.section.market.title: 交易市场
help.section.market.about: The Market tab opens Avakot Market, the player trading site for Soulframe.
help.section.market.inApp.title: Inside the App
help.section.market.inApp.body: The Market button and every View on Market link open the market in its own tab, next to your sidebar. Signing in there is separate from your Little Genius sign-in.
help.section.market.listings.title: Listings on Item Cards
help.section.market.listings.body: Open an item in your Collection to see current market listings for it, with the tempers each copy rolled.
help.section.market.browser.title: On the Web
help.section.market.browser.body: In the browser version, Market opens Avakot Market in a new tab.
help.section.soulmap.title: Soulmap
help.section.soulmap.intro: Soulmap 是一张《Soulframe》世界的交互式地图。你可以用它来查找 Boss 位置、采集点、发现地点以及导航地标。
help.section.soulmap.bossTimers.title: Boss Timers on the Map
help.section.soulmap.bossTimers.body: The Soulmap inside the app shows your boss timers on the map, so you can see what is up and what is still on cooldown.
help.section.soulmap.viewLocation.title: View Location
help.section.soulmap.viewLocation.body: The View location button on a boss timer opens the Soulmap on that boss's exact spot. Discoveries in Mastery Helper link to the map the same way.
help.section.soulmap.keepLoaded.title: Keeping It Loaded
help.section.soulmap.keepLoaded.body: Keep Soulmap running in the background (Settings, General) keeps the map loaded when you switch tabs, so your position is kept. It uses more memory.
help.section.soulmap.onTheWeb.title: 网页模式
help.section.soulmap.onTheWeb.body: 在浏览器版本中，Soulmap 会在新标签页中打开。在原生应用中则是内嵌显示，你可以在它和 Little Genius 的其他部分之间切换，而不会丢失当前位置。
help.section.sidebarEvents.title: 事件 & Boss 计时器
help.section.sidebarEvents.about: The Events tab counts down to everything on a timer: world bosses, the daily reset, Avakot's Gots, Zenith Wares and your Wevetseed.
help.section.sidebarEvents.bosses.title: World Bosses
help.section.sidebarEvents.bosses.body: Each boss card shows the time until that boss is available again, and switches to Available when it is. Cogah variants are tracked separately.
help.section.sidebarEvents.resets.title: Resets
help.section.sidebarEvents.resets.body: Daily Reset counts down to 00:00 UTC. Avakot's Gots and Zenith Wares each have their own reset timer.
help.section.sidebarEvents.wevetseedTime: The Wevetseed card counts down to your next refill.
help.section.sidebarEvents.boons.title: Account Boons
help.section.sidebarEvents.boons.body: Active account boons are listed with the time they have left.
help.section.sidebarEvents.pinning.title: Pinning
help.section.sidebarEvents.pinning.body: Right-click a boss card to pin it to the top. Free accounts share five pins across the whole app; supporters have no limit.
help.section.sidebarEvents.alerts.title: Notifications
help.section.sidebarEvents.alerts.body: The bell on a boss card turns alerts on for that boss. Sounds, volume and whole categories are set under Settings, Notifications.
help.section.sidebarResources.title: 製造材料
help.section.sidebarResources.intro: 资源标签页会汇总你所有已追踪配方所需的各类制作材料数量，并显示你当前拥有的库存。让你一眼就能看出哪些材料缺失。
help.section.sidebarResources.haveNeed.b: A resource something needs shows what you have next to what you need, green when you have enough and red when you are short. Resources nothing needs show a plain count.
help.section.sidebarResources.liveCounts: 同步后，资源数量会自动更新，无需手动输入。
help.section.sidebarResources.showMissin: 在搜索栏旁切换缺少开关，即可隐藏那些你已经拥有足够数量的资源。非常适合用来生成一份更专注的刷材料清单。
help.section.sidebarResources.columns.bo: Each resource is one line. Make the sidebar wider and the list flows into more columns.
help.section.sidebarResources.details.bo: Click a resource to see where it drops, which vendors sell it and what it is used to craft.
help.section.sidebarResources.pins.title: Pinning
help.section.sidebarResources.pins.body: Right-click a resource to pin it to the top. The five free pins are shared across the whole app; supporters have no limit.
help.section.sidebarJoineries.title: 接合材料
help.section.sidebarJoineries.about: Joineries socket into weapons for stat bonuses. The Joineries tab lists every one by family, with how many you own.
help.section.sidebarJoineries.families.b: Each family runs from Rusted through Tempered and Polished to the Blessed tiers. The number on the right is how many you own.
help.section.sidebarJoineries.deities.bo: The strip on the left of a Blessed joinery shows its deity: red for Mora, blue for Saphene, green for Iridis.
help.section.sidebarJoineries.details.bo: Click a joinery to see its stats, the weapon types it fits and where it drops.
help.section.sidebarJoineries.pinning.bo: 右键任意接合材料卡片即可进行置顶或取消置顶操作。被固定的接合材料会始终显示在列表顶部。免费用户最多可置顶 5 个，同样的上限适用；Patreon 支持者可享受无限置顶数量。
help.section.sidebarJoineries.pinning.ct: 切换到接合材料标签页
help.section.sidebarPlanner.heading: Planner
help.section.sidebarPlanner.about: The Planner tab turns a wish list into a farming list: add the items you want and it shows what to farm and where.
help.section.sidebarPlanner.adding.title: Adding Items
help.section.sidebarPlanner.adding.body: Right-click an item in your Collection and choose Add to planner. Mastery Helper can add everything you are missing in one go.
help.section.sidebarPlanner.sources.body: Each item lists the resources and fragments it needs with their drop sources. You can pick one source to use for everything it covers.
help.section.sidebarPlanner.pool.title: Pool Size
help.section.sidebarPlanner.pool.body: Free accounts hold five items in the pool; supporters have no limit.
help.section.sidebarStandings.title: 势力声望
help.section.sidebarStandings.intro: 势力声望标签页显示你当前在各个势力中的声望等级，以及在每日上限重置之前，你今天还能获得多少声望。
help.section.sidebarStandings.dailyStand: 每个阵营都有每日可获取声望的上限。势力声望标签页会准确显示你今天剩余还能获取的声望值，方便你判断是否值得继续刷任务。
help.section.sidebarStandings.factionPro: 每个势力卡片都会显示你当前的等级、晋升到下一级所需的声望阈值，以及一个进度条，用来直观展示你当前的推进程度。
Ode Infamy has its own daily cap. Show Ode Infamy in Settings, General adds it next to the regular factions.
help.section.sidebarStandings.rightClick: 右键点击任意势力卡片，即可将其置顶到势力排序标签页顶部。如果你长期刷某一个势力，这个功能可以让它始终保持在视野中，方便追踪进度。
help.section.sidebarStandings.resetCount: 倒计时会显示每日声望上限的重置时间（UTC 午夜）。你可以据此安排一天结束前的刷取或收尾任务。
切换到势力声望标签页
help.section.sidebarFoundry.title: 铁匠
help.section.sidebarFoundry.about: The Foundry tab shows what is crafting right now and what is ready to collect.
help.section.sidebarFoundry.activeCrafts: Each craft in progress shows a countdown. When it finishes it moves to Ready to Collect.
help.section.sidebarFoundry.bell.title: Notifications
help.section.sidebarFoundry.bell.body: Tap the bell on a craft to be notified when it finishes.
help.section.sidebarCalendar.heading: Calendar
help.section.sidebarCalendar.about: The Calendar tab lists what each day offers: Zenith's weapons and the Gods and Ghosts encounter.
help.section.sidebarCalendar.days.title: Day by Day
help.section.sidebarCalendar.days.body: Days are listed in order, with Today and Yesterday marked. A weapon you have an alert set for is highlighted.
help.section.sidebarCompanions.heading: Companions
help.section.sidebarCompanions.about: The Companions tab shows your wolf pup: Temperament, Bond, Energy and how its training is going.
Each skill is shown in paws, so you can see how far its training has come.
help.section.sidebarCycle.title: 世界轮换条
help.section.sidebarCycle.intro: 侧边栏日期下方的细长条显示的是密德拉世界轮换——由三个交替阶段（萨菲茵、莫拉、伊瑞迪斯）组成，它们会改变世界中的游戏玩法特性。
help.section.sidebarCycle.phasePips.body: 三个图标会在该条带上滚动，分别代表三个轮换阶段。当前激活的阶段会被高亮并略微放大。随着轮换推进，该条带会实时移动更新。
help.section.sidebarCycle.countdown.body: 条带右侧的文字会显示“Day in X:XX”或“Night in X:XX”，表示在当前轮换阶段内，距离下一次昼夜切换还剩多少时间。
help.section.sidebarCycle.phaseColors.bo: 每个阶段都有对应颜色：萨菲茵为蓝色（优雅），莫拉为红色（勇气），伊瑞迪斯为绿色（精神）。这些颜色与应用中其他系统使用的奇能配色保持一致。
help.section.hotkeys.title: 快捷键
help.section.hotkeys.intro: 将键盘快捷键绑定到应用操作。热键为系统级生效——即使在游戏或其他窗口处于焦点时也能触发。
help.section.hotkeys.sidebarCycleKey.bod: F4 cycles through the right sidebar tabs. You can rebind it or remove it under Settings, Hotkeys.
help.section.hotkeys.openHelp.title: 打开指南
help.section.hotkeys.openHelp.body: 按 F1 键可打开此指南。不同于其他快捷键，F1 仅在应用窗口获得焦点时触发，不会在系统范围内生效。
help.section.hotkeys.rebinding.title: Customizing Bindings
help.section.hotkeys.rebinding.body: Open Settings and switch to Hotkeys. Click a key badge to rebind: press any key or combo (Ctrl, Alt, Shift + key). Click × on a row to remove a binding. Press Escape to cancel.
help.section.hotkeys.moreActions.title: Adding Bindings
help.section.hotkeys.moreActions.body: Pick an action at the bottom of the Hotkeys panel to bind it. Every main view has a Go to action you can bind.
help.section.settings.title: 設定
help.section.settings.intro: 设置允许你根据自己的玩法来调整 Little Genius。大多数更改会立即生效，无需重启。
help.section.settings.hiddenItems.title: Founder & Unobtainable Items
help.section.settings.hiddenItems.body: Disable Founder Items and Disable Unobtainable Items hide those items from your Collection, so the totals only count what you can still get.
help.section.settings.tableView.title: Inventory Table View
help.section.settings.tableView.body: Shows the Collection as a compact table instead of cards.
help.section.settings.completionist.body: Sets the goal for Totems to three Rank 3 copies, one per weapon slot. Runes stay at one.
help.section.settings.sidebarOptions.bod: Show Ode Infamy adds it to the Standings tab. Show slots as used / total changes how storage and totem slots read in the sidebar.
help.section.settings.links.title: Open Links in Browser
help.section.settings.links.body: Opens the wiki and other web links in your default browser instead of a Little Genius window.
help.section.settings.runInBackground.bo: 关闭窗口后仍可保持 Little Genius 运行。应用会保留在系统后台程序中，并持续追踪计时器和库存数据。
help.section.settings.notificationsTab.b: The Notifications tab has a master switch, volume, the alert sound (your own sound files included) and a switch for each kind of alert: world bosses, vendor resets, Wevetseed, Foundry crafts, weapon drops and more.
help.section.settings.unpinAll.title: Unpin All
help.section.settings.unpinAll.body: Unpin all (everywhere) clears every pin in every panel at once.
help.section.settings.windowZoom.title: Window Zoom
help.section.settings.windowZoom.body: Window zoom lives in the account panel. Use the stepper or type a percentage.
help.section.patreon.title: 會員特權
help.section.patreon.intro: 在 Patreon 上支持 Avakot.org 有助于维持应用运行，并可解锁少量便利性功能。但所有核心追踪功能始终免费，并且未来也会保持免费。
help.section.patreon.pinLimit.title: Unlimited Pins
help.section.patreon.pinLimit.body: Free accounts have five pins shared across the app. Supporters can pin as much as they like.
help.section.patreon.resizableSidebar.bo: 将右侧边栏的左边缘向左或向右拖动，可以让它变宽或变窄。双击拖拽手柄可以恢复为默认宽度。你选择的宽度会在不同会话之间自动保存。
help.section.patreon.history.title: Full Journal & Longer Analysis
help.section.patreon.history.body: Supporters keep their whole journal history, can export it as CSV, and get the 7 day, 30 day and all time ranges and per-item graphs in Session Analysis.
help.section.patreon.noLimits.title: No Build or Planner Limits
help.section.patreon.noLimits.body: Saved builds (three free) and the Planner pool (five free) have no limit.
help.section.patreon.cloud.title: Cloud Sync
help.section.patreon.cloud.body: Back up your settings, pins, keybinds and alert preferences to your account and restore them on another device.
help.section.patreon.adFree.title: 純淨體驗，無廣告
help.section.patreon.adFree.body: 免费用户会看到一个小型广告面板以及偶尔的 Patreon 赞助提示。支持者则不会看到这些内容——界面保持干净且不受打扰。
help.section.patreon.communityVoice.body: 支持者可以直接与开发者沟通——提交功能需求、优先反馈 bug，并参与下一步功能投票。产品路线图由使用最频繁的人共同塑造。
在 Patreon 上完成赞助后，请在 Patreon 设置页面绑定你的 Discord 账号。然后使用同一个 Discord 账号登录 Little Genius，你的等级将会被自动识别。
help.section.patreon.supporterPrompt.bod: 如果你在未登录状态下使用 Little Genius 一段时间，有时会看到 Patreon 的提示。你可以随时关闭它——该提示仅会出现在网页版本中。
help.section.patreon.supporterPrompt.cta: 透過 Patreon 支持我們
